_comment: All ballistics math runs in METRES and SECONDS. The Roblox layer converts at the engine boundary using studsPerMetre. Nothing here may be duplicated in Luau.
_dragModel: Quadratic drag linearised along the flight path: v(s) = v0 * exp(-k*s). k has units 1/m. 1/k is the distance over which speed falls by 1/e.

_designTargets.note: These are the two numbers the whole skill curve rests on. Ballistics specs assert against them, and tools/tune-report regenerates them.
